description: This file defines a generic grain class 'SimpleGenericGrain<TType>' for Orleans framework, implementing basic get/set and comparison functionalities for grain references, used in unit testing scenarios.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain<TType>
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain class implementing ISimpleGenericGrain<TType> with methods for setting, getting, transforming, and comparing grain references.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal value of the grain.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: A placeholder method for transforming the grain's state.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value stored in the grain.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Compares the grain reference with a client-provided reference to ensure they point to the same grain.
